```html
<body>
  <ui-container size="md">
    <ui-stack gap="lg">
      <ui-heading level="1">Settings</ui-heading>

      <form id="settings-form" action="/settings" method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data">
        <ui-stack gap="lg">

          <ui-card>
            <ui-card-header>
              <ui-heading level="2">Profile</ui-heading>
              <ui-text variant="muted">Update your personal information.</ui-text>
            </ui-card-header>
            <ui-card-body>
              <ui-stack gap="md">
                <ui-field label="Name" for="name" required>
                  <ui-input id="name" name="name" type="text" placeholder="Jane Doe" required></ui-input>
                </ui-field>
                <ui-field label="Email" for="email" hint="We'll never share your email." required>
                  <ui-input id="email" name="email" type="email" placeholder="jane@example.com" required></ui-input>
                </ui-field>
                <ui-field label="Avatar" for="avatar" hint="PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB.">
                  <ui-stack direction="horizontal" gap="md" align="center">
                    <ui-avatar size="lg" name="Jane Doe"></ui-avatar>
                    <ui-file-upload id="avatar" name="avatar" accept="image/png, image/jpeg" max-size="2MB">
                      Upload image
                    </ui-file-upload>
                  </ui-stack>
                </ui-field>
              </ui-stack>
            </ui-card-body>
          </ui-card>

          <ui-card>
            <ui-card-header>
              <ui-heading level="2">Notifications</ui-heading>
              <ui-text variant="muted">Choose what you want to be notified about.</ui-text>
            </ui-card-header>
            <ui-card-body>
              <ui-stack gap="md">
                <ui-switch name="notify-email" checked>Email notifications</ui-switch>
                <ui-switch name="notify-push">Push notifications</ui-switch>
                <ui-switch name="notify-newsletter" checked>Weekly newsletter</ui-switch>
              </ui-stack>
            </ui-card-body>
          </ui-card>

          <ui-stack direction="horizontal" justify="end">
            <ui-button type="submit" variant="primary">Save changes</ui-button>
          </ui-stack>

        </ui-stack>
      </form>

      <ui-card variant="danger">
        <ui-card-header>
          <ui-heading level="2">Danger zone</ui-heading>
          <ui-text variant="muted">Permanently delete your account and all of its data. This cannot be undone.</ui-text>
        </ui-card-header>
        <ui-card-body>
          <form action="/account/delete" method="post">
            <ui-button type="submit" variant="danger">Delete account</ui-button>
          </form>
        </ui-card-body>
      </ui-card>

    </ui-stack>
  </ui-container>
</body>
```
